scoring_rationale: Base 100. -5 for stale certified count in primary governance doc (AGENTS.md). -5 for pervasive cross-reference naming error (PROJECT_CONSTITUTION.md vs 00_PROJECT_CONSTITUTION.md — affects 11+ documents). -3 for 3 missing dependency documents (EXAM_BLUEPRINT.md, CASE_STUDY_GOLD_STANDARD.md, CASE_STUDY_SCORING_RUBRIC.md — though likely superseded by CAQS and TAXONOMY_REGISTRY sections). -3 for stale pool-size metadata in TAXONOMY_REGISTRY.md (5 sections). -2 for stale scope in QUESTION_METADATA_STANDARD.md and CAQS_v1.0.md migration/baseline sections. Core governance framework (DCS v1.1, CAQS, DEFECT_LIBRARY, CURRENT_BASELINES, REVISION_HISTORY, BACKUP_PROTOCOL) is robust and actively maintained.
blocking_issues: AGENTS.md §8 and §9 contain stale certified count (~1,080 vs actual 2,181) — this is the primary governance document for all AI sessions. The stale count perpetuates across every new session's startup protocol.

Pervasive cross-reference naming: 11+ documents reference 'PROJECT_CONSTITUTION.md' but no such file exists — the Constitution is at '00_PROJECT_CONSTITUTION.md'. This causes every dependency resolution to fail silently.
